tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha khang chen mor sngags 'chang bla ma'i 'khrungs rabs gsar du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bzhugs// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod kyi/ /byang ngos logs bris gsar du bskrun pa 'di/ /rje btsun sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams 'khrungs rabs te/ /skyes chen 'di yi thog ma'i sprul gzhi ni/ /ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dpal smra seng ste/ /de nyid shākya'i dus su mo'u 'gal bur/ /sprul zhing slob dpon pad+ma sam bha'i dus/ /rdzogs chen mnga' bdag shrī singhar grags/ /chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /'jam dbyangs ngo bo blon po mgar du sprul/ /'phags pa'i yul du zhi ba 'tsho nyid dang / /gnas lnga rig pa mi thub zla ba sogs/ /paṇ+ḍi ta yi skye ba bcu gcig tu/ /brgyud mar bzhes shing sgo mtha' yas pa yi/ /blo gros la sogs rab byung sngags pa yi/ /rten can rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skye ba drug /bar ma chad par byon te gangs khrod 'dir/ /sna nam chen po rdo rje bdud 'joms dang / /lcog ro klu rgyal gyi jo zla 'od sogs/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā du ma'i skur 'khrungs shing / /de nas 'jam dpal dge bsnyen zol 'dzin pa/ /dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs dang grags pa'i mtshan/ /mched du sprul nas bstan 'gro'i don mang mdzad/ /phyis rabs 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /rgya nag rtas ming chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /gtsug gi nor bur zhabs zung ngal 'tsho ba'i/ /skyes mchog dam pa theg chen chos rje dang / /mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po go ram rje/ /rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs/ /skyes mchog so sor sprul nas 'gro don mdzad/ /des na 'phags pa'i yul du sngon byon pa'i/ /slob dpon chen po shrī singha dang / /bod kyi sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms zhabs/ /'gro mgon chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang /

/phyis byon klong chen rab 'byams zhes bya rnams/ /rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' mtshan can dang / /thugs rgyud gcig par rnam thar dag las shes/ /rgyu mtshan de phyir skyes chen de thams cad/ /sngags 'chang bla ma'i sngon gyi skyes rabs su/ /bsnyon med grub cing dam pa de kun gyis/ /mkhyen brtse bsdus nas snyigs ma'i mthar thug 'dir/ /mdo sngags rig gnas spyi dang khyad par du/ /sa skya'i yab chos rgyud gsum man ngag gi /bstan pa gso phyir bsam bzhin byon pa ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho rje 'di dang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho thugs gcig par yang mi 'gal lam snyam mo/ ste/ /de nyid slar yang bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /rlabs chen bsgrub phyir 'gran bral gdung rigs su/ /ched du sprul nas dus ngan 'di 'dra la/ /spyir gyi bstan dang khyad par sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa bstan 'dzin dgon gnas dang bcas pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rnam thar 'di 'dra bsam tshe skyes chen 'di/ /mthong thos dran reg kun kyang don can zhes/ /ding sang ljongs 'dir kun kyang gtam du gleng / /de ltar rnam 'dren dam pa'i skyes rabs 'di/ /'phrin las mgon po mchog gi lung bstan dang / /sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar so so la/ /dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis yang yang du/ /dpyad pas nges pa rnyed bzhin bris pa yi/ /sku brnyan 'di rnams bzo yi rig byed mkhan/ /bi shwa karma'i phyag sor 'du byed la/ /co 'dri nus pa'i shes rab 'byung gnas dang / /rnam dpyod mig yangs grags pa rin chen sogs/ /mched grogs lnga yi sor rtse'i 'phrul las grub/ /'di yi sbyin bdag sngags 'chang bla ma yi/ /zhabs 'bring bgyid pa'i shākya'i dge slong gang / /byams pa bsod nams rab brtan zhes bya bas/ /bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pas bgyis/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/

/drin can bla ma mkhan chen chos kyi rje/ /bstan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin de dang / /legs byas bsod nams me shel khams las grub/ /lugs zung mkhyen pa'i 'od zer 'bum 'phro ba'i/ /bka' drin mnyam med khu dbon rnam gnyis kyi/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa dang / /khyad par gangs ljongs 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs/ /ding sang bstan 'dzin kun gyi rgyan gcig pu/ /sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /zhabs pad bskal brgya'i bar du brtan gyur cig /bdag kyang dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing / /'di dang phyi ma'i bsam pa'i don thams cad/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyur bsngo 'o/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /yi dam chos skyong nor lhar bcas pa yi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul bsam yas kyis/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis byon/ /dkar chag 'di ni logs bris kyi/ /sbyin bdag nye gnas slob bu yis/ /nan gyis bskul ngo ma chog par/ /gdod nas rang grol zhes byas bris/ /ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //'khrungs rabs kyi zhal byang 'di ltar bri bar bya ste// ༈ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs 'jam dpal smra seng rgyal/ /dgra bcom rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur mo'u 'gal bu la 'dud/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po shrī singha rgyal/ /chos kyi blon po chen po mgar ba stong btsan 'dud/ /bod yul 'dul 'dzin sgo 'byed zhi ba 'tsho nyid rgyal/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen mi thub zla bar 'dud/ /paṇa grub sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros mtshan can rgyal/ /sna nam chen po rdo rje bdud 'joms zhabs la 'dud/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā lcog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan rgyal/ /skad gnyis smra ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od la 'dud/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs pad rgyal/ /gangs khrod rdor 'dzin gtsug rgyan grags pa'i mtshan la 'dud/

/'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan rtag tu rgyal/ /theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i gsal byed go ram rje nyid rgyal/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug klong chen rab 'byams zhabs la 'dud/ /rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal rgyal/ /thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'phrin las mnga' bdag mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho rgyal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs kun dga'i mtshan can rgyal/ /zhes bri bar bya'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ lha khang chen mor sngags 'chang bla ma'i 'khrungs rabs gsar du bzhengs pa' pa'i dkar chag/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
